intro.title: Invert Binary Tree
intro.body: In this lesson, you'll build a function that inverts a binary tree, flipping it horizontally so that each left child becomes a right child and vice versa. You'll learn the core concept of tree traversal, specifically using recursion to visit and swap nodes. The main technologies involved are JavaScript functions, recursion, and basic tree node structures. This exercise will help you understand how to manipulate tree data structures and think recursively, which are fundamental skills in algorithm design.
intro.usecase: Inverting a binary tree is a core pattern for manipulating hierarchical data structures, which appear in many real-world UI components. For example, you might use this algorithm to flip a nested navigation menu, reverse the order of a collapsible file explorer, or mirror a tree-view component in a dashboard. Understanding this concept helps developers efficiently reorganize or transform any tree-like data, such as comment threads, organizational charts, or settings panels, by recursively swapping child nodes.
